newsitem.title: HUNGARY: RESEARCH ALERT - BChem rated long-term buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - BChem rated long-term buy.

text.p: WestMerchant assigned a 'long-term buy' rating on shares in Hungarian chemicals firm BorsodChem Rt saying that potential expansion of the group could boost its price.

"Potential expansion of the group via acquisition could provide the catalyst for further price appreciation if this reduces the group's earnings volatility," analysts Martin Catling and Rober Feuer said in a company report, dated June 13.
In September 1996 WestMerchant gave a 'buy' rating for BorsodChem.
The analysts anticipated that BorsodChem's management was evaluating a number of possible acquisitions with petrochemical plants in central or eastern Europe seen as likely targets.
"If anything tangible materialises from this it could well provide the catalyst for a further enhancement of BorsodChem's value in both absolute and relative terms," they said.
On Tuesday BorsodChem ended at 7,105 forints, up 60.
